Improve Droid E2E startup reliability with configurable timeouts and warmup

retry attempts/timeouts via env vars, and a best-effort warmup run in CI to reduce
first-session flake. Updates README with Droid agent documentation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
